source_title: Pierre Sage press conference: Tottenham vs Crystal Palace - BBC
source_excerpt:
Crystal Palace boss Pierre Sage has been speaking to the media before Saturday's Premier League game against Spurs at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium (kick-off 17:30 GMT).
Here are the key lines from his news conference:
Jean-Philippe Mateta is "ready to play and to start" after being rested for the Carabao Cup tie against Fulham . Sage explained: "I managed him because he had played two 60-minute periods in the past seven days. Normally he only has to play two 30-minute periods, so that's why we left him out."

However, Ismaila Sarr is "not able to play" and expected to be out until after the November international break.

Jorgen Strand Larsen will return to first-team training on Thursday and Quinten Timber on Friday. Both players could feature this weekend.

On whether his rotated side, which reached the Carabao Cup quarter-finals, gave him food for thought: "Yes. Some players need those kind of games to find their habits and show their real level. Some of them gave me a good message and it is always better to have more solutions."

I want to thank them, but I prefer when they are behind the whole team rather than me alone. The team need it more than me, but it is really appreciated by me."
